title: junaidaslam/gojri-english-dictionary
description:
Gojri-English dictionary text corpus
	


	
		
	
	
		Dataset summary
	

Digitized text of the printed Gojri-English Dictionary compiled by Dr. Javaid Rahi. The dataset covers 474 body pages (pages 25 to 498) and includes 11,767 dictionary entry lines. Each line contains Gojri headwords in Perso-Arabic (Nastaliq) script, Latin transliterations, part-of-speech tags, and English definitions.

	
		
	
	
		Author and source credits
	


Original author and compiler: Dr. Javaid Rahi
Source… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/junaidaslam/gojri-english-dictionary.
